quiz.title: Find the Right Bundle
quiz.subtitle: Answer a few quick questions and we'll match your child with the perfect starter kit. Takes under 2 minutes.
quiz.q3: How careful are they with their things?
quiz.q4: What's their experience with Pokémon cards?
quiz.q6: Do they have a favorite Pokémon? (optional)

guided_tour.step1_body: Here's what's in your bundle. Each item is listed with a short explanation of what it is and why it's included.
guided_tour.step2_body: We ship within 1–3 business days. Most orders arrive in 5–7 business days. You'll get a tracking number by email.
guided_tour.step3_body: Pokémon packs are randomized — think of them like surprise bags. Most packs won't contain rare cards, and that's normal. The fun is in the surprise.
guided_tour.step4_body: Sealed products can be returned within 30 days. Once packs are opened, we can't accept returns (because the contents are random). Supplies like binders and sleeves can be returned unused.
guided_tour.step5_body: We accept all major cards and PayPal. Tax is calculated at checkout based on your location. No hidden fees.
